
DESCRIPTION
Add a project from a technology stack

USAGE
  one add [template-id] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one add
  one add react-spa --name web --yes

TIPS
Adds a project ready for local development. Choose its deployment target the first time you run one deploy.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -n, --name <value>       Project name
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  -y, --yes                Run non-interactively

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  --deploy-provider <value> Configure a compatible deployment target immediately (automation/advanced)
